summary: HD character selection screen replaces InterfaceNdSelectChar
author: pm
body:
The user finished the HD character selection screen: `working/classic_ui/hd/character_selection_screen.png` (2163x1084 RGBA, 2026-11-25 16:46, PSD beside it). Wire it into `Screen_SelectCharacter` in place of the low-res `InterfaceNdSelectChar` sheet (d-035), with no fallback to the old art (d-036).

| part | art rect (measured) | notes |
|---|---|---|
| backdrop | x 0-1919, y 0-1079 | rune wall, roped "Character List" frame (upper), wooden plank panel (lower); about 6k fully transparent edge pixels |
| card, normal | x 1920-2160, y 2-403 (about 241x402) | grey parchment, NAME / LEV / EXP labels, transparent portrait oval |
| card, selected | x 1920-2160, y 414-815 (about 241x402) | gold variant, same layout |

The current screen draws 4 slots 109 UI px apart (`render_character_previews`, `screen_select_character.cpp`), and the HD art maps at art = 240 + ui*1.8 (cover fit). A 241 art px card is about 134 UI px wide, so the old slot pitch cannot be kept as is. The layout of the four cards inside the roped frame is NOT decided: a mockup goes to the user for approval first.

**Done when:** the user approves an in-client screenshot; the old sheet is archived and its load removed; the build is clean and review passed.

Source: user message, 2026-11-25; measured with PIL.

**Editor findings, 2026-11-25 (mockup stage, no code changed).** Measured with PIL on the sheet:

- Backdrop alpha bounds are sheet x 2-1921, y 2-1081 (1920x1080 offset 2 px into the sheet), not 0-1919.
- Cards (trimmed): normal x 1932-2160, y 2-403; selected x 1932-2160, y 414-815; 229x402 each (not 241: x 1920-1921 is backdrop bleed).
- Card-local: oval x 38-187, y 39-239; NAME box y 267-297; LEV box y 304-330; EXP box y 336-362 (value boxes from x ~72).
- Roped frame outer (backdrop px): x 431-1489, y 65-466 (UI 106-694, 36-259). Title plank bottom about y 106. Plank panel x 413-1510, y 558-1044 (UI 96-706, 310-580).
- Old cards: `InterfaceNdButton` frames 61/62 are 107x187 UI, drawn at UI (183 + 109i, 114).

Mockups in `.claude/scratch/editor/hh0108/`:
- A `mockup_original_layout.png`: native cards, 20 art px gaps, pitch 249 art = 138.33 UI, row x 472-1448 art, y 118-520 (UI x 128.89 + 138.33i, y 65.56).
- B `mockup_old_footprint.png`: old footprint, scale 0.837.
- Each has an `_4x3_800x600` crop. Both rows sit inside the 4:3 window (art x 240-1680).

Clash: the original tooltip and default text start at UI y 290, above the plank top (UI 310), so the first lines draw on the dark gap. Buttons, account info and footer land on the plank. The old plank's inset boxes are gone (one inset now).

**Correction, 2026-11-25:** the earlier "help text starts above the plank" clash was a mockup-script error. The script left out the code's `OY` (60) for the help text and account info. In the real layout they sit at UI y 350-440 and 455-500, already on the HD plank inset. The original plank group (UI 178-620 x 348-531) fits the inset (UI 137.8-662.8 x 348.9-543.3) with a shift of (+1, +7).

**v3 (in-client render, uncommitted, guard dc7a23ce open):**
- `screen_select_character.{h,cpp}` draw the HD sheet (`staged/client/sprites/interface/front_end/character_select.png`, a byte-identical copy of the user's PNG).
- The cards are mockup A's row: UI x 129/267/406/544, y 66, 127x223. The real button art is the panel kit.
- The plank group is moved as one by (+1, +7) and placed through this frame's cover fit.
- Screenshot: `.claude/scratch/editor/hh0108/mockup_a_v3.png` (1280x960, hhtest5127, slot 1 filled and gold, Start hovered).
- The old sheet's load, `sprite_id.h` and frames 61/62 are not retired yet; that waits on layout approval.

**Editor outcome, 2026-11-25 (v4 finished, uncommitted, for review).**

- **Art:** the user's art was updated 19:26. The plank and inset moved up 50 art px and the rope frame and sign about 21. The backdrop bounds (sheet 2-1921 x 2-1081) and the cards (x 1932-2160; y 2-403 and 414-815) did not move.
- **Derived sheet:** `tools/front_end/make_select_backdrop.py` (README beside it, `--dry-run`) bakes the generated recessed boxes into `staged/client/sprites/interface/front_end/character_select.png`. The boxes in UI px:
  - help: x 144.8-450.9, y 326.9-442.2;
  - account: x 144.8-450.9, y 450.4-512.1;
  - footer strip: x 180.2-407.3, y 522.8-546.1.
- **Screen:** `screen_select_character.{h,cpp}` draws the sheet through the cover fit.
  - Cards: art y 97, UI x 129/267/406/544, y 54, 127x223. Gold when focused.
  - Buttons: panel kit, about 35 UI apart. Hit rects x 468, y 330 (185x32), then 368/403/438/472 (185x29).
  - The help, account and footer text map from the old inset onto the new one.
  - The copyright and version text are unchanged and now clear the plank (seen in the capture).
- **Old sheet retired (d-035, d-036):**
  - `005.png` archived to `working/archive/interface/intermediate_screens/005_2026-11-25.png`; sha256 2a55f50b... matches.
  - Manifest placeholder for index 5, `git rm` of the image, and `gen_sprite_index.py` run (index current).
  - Load removed from `screen_loading.cpp` (sprite 6 kept) and `InterfaceNdSelectChar` removed from `sprite_id.h`.
- **Frames 61/62 (HH-0099):** nothing draws them. No code draws from the `InterfaceNdButton` sheet (010) at all; it is only loaded, since `draw_text_button` uses the panel kit. The manifest has no per-frame retire flag, so the frames stay in the sheet.
- **Build and run:** `-Target All -Config Debug` clean (`-NoDeploy`, then a client-only deploy, because the server was running). Captures in `.claude/scratch/editor/hh0108/`: `final_idle_4x3.png` and `final_hover_start_4x3.png`.
- **Guards open:** dc7a23ce (screen_select_character.cpp/.h) and f3774464 (screen_loading.cpp, sprite_id.h).
- **Not verified:** a 16:9 window (no window-size option).

**Addendum, 2026-11-25 (button and text scale; this replaces the button numbers above).**

- **Buttons:** the faces and hit rects now scale with the plank mapping.
  - Faces are 207x28 (176 x 1.177, 24 x 1.164).
  - Hit rects (measured): x 452; y 327 (218x37), then 366/401/436/470 (218x34).
  - They draw through a new `CGame::draw_text_button_in(frame, kit_rect)` (game.h/.cpp, guard bbd2a468). `draw_text_button` now calls it.
  - The label keeps the panel kit's `wide_button_label` size (14 px). Kit recipes have one fixed px, so a larger label needs a new recipe in the kit (`tools/panel_kit`), which is not done here.
- **Plank text** (help, account info, footer label): font size 14 (default 12 x 1.164), lines about 17.5 UI apart.
- **Copyright and version:** untouched. They clear the plank.
- **Captures** in `.claude/scratch/editor/hh0108/`:
  - `final_idle_4x3.png` and `final_hover_start_4x3.png`;
  - `final_4x3_800x600.png`;
  - `side_by_side_final.png` (original 005.png upscaled for reference only).
- **Build:** `-Target All` clean (0 compiler warnings), client-only deploy.

**Addendum, 2026-11-25 (boxes aligned, buttons nudged; this replaces the box and button numbers above).**

- **Layout:** one 7 UI px margin on the plank inset (UI x 137.78-662.78, y 321.11-515.56), used everywhere:
  - inset to boxes;
  - between the boxes;
  - boxes to buttons;
  - buttons to the inset's right edge.
- **Boxes** (UI px, shared left and right edges x 144.78-441.78):
  - help y 328.11-441.08;
  - account y 448.08-508.56 (original 99:53 height ratio);
  - footer strip y 522.80-546.09, centred on the bottom border.
- **Text:** centred both ways in each box. Blank account lines (the empty IP line) are left out, so the rest centre.
- **Buttons:**
  - Faces x 448.78-655.78, 207x28, y 328.11 + 38.11k: the stack spans the boxes' top to bottom. That moves them 8.1 UI px left.
  - Hit rects (measured): x 444; y 322 (218x37), then 364/402/440/479 (218x34).
- **Code:** one set of numbers in `screen_select_character.cpp` and `tools/front_end/make_select_backdrop.py` (`boxes()`), which must agree.
- **Build:** `-Target All` clean (0 compiler warnings), client deployed.
- **Captures:** `final_idle_4x3.png`, `final_hover_start_4x3.png` (saved at half size), `final_4x3_800x600.png`, `side_by_side_final.png`.

**Landed, 2026-11-25:** user approved the final capture on the 19:26 art. Review passed (no blockers); the cstddef nit was fixed and the client builds clean. Button labels moved to HH-0109.

**Closed, 2026-11-25:** committed 21cb7bda after the user's approval and a passing review.
